# Vendored from the site

Generated by `scripts/vendor-site.js` from `alecldarlow-cell/dailynoodle` at
`0c9a6b083e3f97ceb160b07088811d7b4b110dbf`. Used only by the differential tests; never imported by the app.

- `dn-core.js`: verbatim copy.
- `site.js`: functions lifted by name from `front.js` and `engines/*.js`.
- `dn-board.js`: verbatim copy (leagues: state, backfill, personal link, claim, submit).
- `dn-move.js`: `dn-track.js`'s `#dnmove=` import block, verbatim.

Regenerate after the site changes any of them:

```sh
node scripts/vendor-site.js --site ../dailynoodle
```
